locomotion: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE six-frame pixel-art locomotion sprite sheet, actual transparent background. Reference is Grimhald's slimmer complete-body character sheet. Create a coherent fluid six-frame WALK/RUN cycle of exactly the SAME armour, closed crowned helmet, crescent axe and crimson cloth. Layout exactly 3 columns x 2 rows of equal cells, generous transparent margins, one COMPLETE connected character in each cell, facing three-quarter right. No parts separated or floating. Axe is braced over his shoulder with a visible gauntlet gripping the wooden haft in every frame. Movement: frame 1 left leg forward contact/right leg behind; frame 2 weight drops with bent knees and rear foot lifting; frame 3 passing pose with right knee coming through and support leg straighter; frame 4 right leg forward contact/left leg behind; frame 5 weight drops on right with left foot lifting; frame 6 passing pose with left knee coming through. Every frame must have a DIFFERENT leg silhouette. Fluid body weight transfer, gentle coordinated hip/shoulder counter-rotation, subtle helmet and axe bob, cloth swings behind the stride. Lean slightly forward but retain the slimmer armour silhouette. Feet share the same ground baseline in every equal cell, pelvis and helmet keep the same general registration. Same body height/scale in all frames; do not shrink or enlarge individual frames. Whole body drawn coherently in each frame; NOT a cutout rig, NOT six copies of one pose, NOT static legs under moving torso. Simple readable blocky low-resolution game sprites, clean outlines, restrained shading, no painterly textures or dither. About 39 logical pixels body height excluding the axe when extracted. No text, labels, arrows, shadows, ground, or border.
transparencyCleanup: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the six-frame Grimhald walking sheet. Do not add any backgrounds, checkerboard drawing, ground or text. The six complete characters must be isolated sprites on a genuinely transparent empty canvas. Retain the connected bodies and distinct leg poses. No other changes.

groundFissure: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent game sprite, a FLAT volcanic FISSURE ON THE GROUND, seen directly FROM ABOVE, orthographic top-down. A long narrow jagged crack running left to right through flat dark ground, ember-orange lava visible INSIDE the crack, thin dark crimson rim and scattered tiny flat chips. The crack is embedded flush in a horizontal floor plane. Absolutely no upright rocks, mountain silhouette, pillar, raised plates, side view, vertical walls, perspective horizon, cast shadow, glow haze or smoke. Simple blocky pixel-art shapes, sharp outlines and 2-3 flat colours per material. Long-to-thin silhouette, intended extraction approximately 40 by 10 logical pixels. Empty genuinely transparent background, no text or labels. Only the crack, no rectangular ground tile or scenery.
